'''Aradasa Vurse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] and daughter of [[Halliava Vurse]], the chief trainer of [[scout]]s for the [[Raining Leaves Clan]]. According to Halliava, Aradasa was her child with [[Dasan]], a warrior from the [[Broken Columns Clan]], which was a tribe of men that regularly [[Marriage/Legends|married]] females from the Raining Leaves Clan.

==Biography==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in search of [[Vestara Khai]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. With them was a number of hired trackers and guides, one of which was [[Tribeless Sha|Sha'natrac Tsu]], a Dathomiri Witch who used to be in the [[Blue Coral Divers Clan/Legends|Blue Coral Divers Clan]]. The Jedi stayed in the company of the Raining Leaves Clan during their [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|annual conclave]] with the Broken Columns Clan. When the clans were attacked by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], who were against the planned merging of the two clans, Tsu was one of the casualties. Ben, however, thought Tsu was more than a random casualty. He theorized that one of the reasons Tsu hired herself as a tracker was because she was searching for her missing daughter stolen by the Nightsisters. Ben started questioning the women of the Raining Leaves Clan who had daughters, and came to suspect that Aradasa was Tsu's missing child.<ref name="Backlash" />

After the [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|battle]] on [[Bright Sun Hill]], where the two clans managed to repel the Nightsisters and merged into the [[Bright Sun Clan]], Halliava revealed her status as a Nightsister when she accused Khai of complicity against the Bright Sun Clan. The Nightsisters were [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] due to Khai's actions, and Halliava was the only one who was left. In response, Khai revealed that it was Halliava who assassinated Tsu. As punishment, Halliava was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the Bright Sun Clan and Aradasa was adopted by [[Olianne Sihn]], who had lost her own [[Sesara Sihn|daughter]] to a fever a few months previously.<ref name="Backlash" />
